caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted bust of a person with a light brown complexion, blue eyes, and a slightly open mouth. The figure has a bald head with the exception of long dark brown hair extending from the left side and rear. Three black feathers are attached to the top of the head, fanned outwards. The bust features prominent earrings on both ears, each consisting of a series of elongated, silver segments. There is a nose ornament, which appears to be a silver ring. The bust is mounted on an ovular, greenish platform. Below the neck on the base of the bust, there is a yellow plaque with an inscription reading, "CAPTAIN JOHN CARLTON, COMMANDER IN CHIEF, JANUARY THE 2nd 1784." The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature can be seen in the bottom right corner.
title: Indian Head
